description: Route design work to the right Apple HIG skill automatically — detects what you're building (component, pattern, platform, surface) via stack-agnostic signals and loads only the relevant rule cards.
Apply Apple HIG design foundations — color, typography, layout/spacing, dark mode, icons, materials, motion, privacy, writing, accessibility — to any surface, technology-agnostic.
Consult Apple HIG component rule cards (buttons, alerts, sheets, tab bars, lists, inputs…) — loads only the card for the component being worked on.
Apply Apple HIG user-experience patterns (entering data, loading, feedback, empty states…) to flows in any technology.
Layer the Apple HIG per-platform deltas (iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS, visionOS) on top of the core rules.
Audit a screen or project against Apple HIG: prioritized deviation list (never a bare score), delta tracking vs previous runs, correction plan with accept/reject/assume.
Run a delta/regression audit comparing the latest run to a previous one for a project.
